invariants.name: no_input_label_only
invariants.description: No input-label-only examples. Every CognitiveUnit must have graph with nodes.

invariants.name: relation_edge_requires_endpoints
invariants.description: Every relation edge requires source and target nodes existing in graph.

invariants.name: cause_requires_effect
invariants.description: Every cause node must have a corresponding effect via causes edge.

invariants.name: near_certainty_requires_evidence
invariants.description: Near certainty policy requires non-empty evidence_refs.

invariants.name: tool_api_not_evidence
invariants.description: Tool or API nodes cannot be used as evidence by themselves without trust policy.

invariants.name: harm_not_haram
invariants.description: harm domain (value/practical) does not imply haram (shari). They are distinct.

invariants.name: ambiguity_caps_certainty
invariants.description: Ambiguous input must not result in near_certainty policy.

invariants.name: metaphor_not_literal
invariants.description: Metaphor nodes are not literal by default. Require explicit grounding.

invariants.name: source_trust_before_evidence
invariants.description: Source nodes must pass trust policy before being used as evidence.

invariants.name: graph_json_serializable
invariants.description: Every graph must be JSON serializable.

invariants.name: vector_matches_registry
invariants.description: Every vector must contain exactly the dimensions defined in registry.

invariants.name: domain_judgment_has_domain_vector
invariants.description: Every domain judgment must include domain_vector.
